questions.question: Uncoupling protein 1 (UCP1), also known as thermogenin, generates heat in brown adipose tissue through which cellular mechanism?
options: Inhibiting the beta-oxidation of fatty acids in the mitochondrial matrix
Allowing protons to re-enter the mitochondrial matrix without driving ATP synthesis
Enhancing the binding affinity of ATP synthase for ADP and inorganic phosphate
Blocking electron transfer through Complex IV of the electron transport chain
